stories.headline: India's net FDI hits a 5.5-year low in September
body: Net foreign direct investment was −$4.95 billion in September, the lowest since at least March 2021.
Gross inflows slumped while outflows jumped 40%.
First-half net FDI was still over 20% higher than last year.
stories.joke: Money left faster than it arrived.
stories.vc: Weak FDI can pressure the rupee.

stories.statLabel: where shared KYC details will sit
stories.headline: SEBI eases KYC rules to simplify investor sign-ups
body: SEBI will centralise common client details at KYC registration agencies.
Investors won't have to resubmit the same details to every broker.
Documents are easier for OCI cardholders and resident foreign nationals.
stories.vc: Easier onboarding could bring more new investors into markets.

stories.headline: Over a third of UK Muslim students face Islamophobia, report says
body: A FOSIS report found 38% of Muslim students in the UK faced Islamophobia.
Students described being spat at, assaulted and humiliated.
One hijab-wearing student said she felt there was no one to report it to.
stories.vc: Safe campuses help universities keep and attract students.
